SELECT uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) AS card_name, uc.memo AS alias, NULLIF(cv.image_url, '') AS card_image_url, ( SELECT cb.title FROM card_benefits cb WHERE cb.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND cb.record_type = 'benefit' ORDER BY cb.position ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS highlight_benefit_title, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(policy_limit.maximum_reward) FROM ( SELECT cb2.content_version_id, blp.limit_policy_id, MAX(blt.limit_value) AS maximum_reward FROM card_benefits cb2 INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.benefit_id = cb2.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies blp ON blp.offer_id = bo.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_limit_tiers blt ON blt.limit_policy_id = blp.limit_policy_id WHERE blp.limit_period = 'monthly' AND blp.limit_type = 'reward_amount' AND blp.limit_unit = 'KRW' GROUP BY cb2.content_version_id, blp.limit_policy_id ) policy_limit WHERE policy_limit.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id ), 0) AS maximum_monthly_benefit_amount, COALESCE(benefit_usage.received_benefit_amount, 0) AS received_benefit_amount, COALESCE(performance.current_spend_amount, 0) AS performance_current_amount,
COALESCE( (SELECT next_tier.minimum_spend_krw FROM card_performance_tiers next_tier WHERE next_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id AND next_tier.minimum_spend_krw > COALESCE(performance.current_spend_amount, 0) ORDER BY next_tier.minimum_spend_krw ASC LIMIT 1), (SELECT MAX(last_tier.minimum_spend_krw) FROM card_performance_tiers last_tier WHERE last_tier.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id), cv.representative_spend, 0) AS performance_target_amount, uc.display_order FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions cv2 WHERE cv2.card_id = cv.card_id AND (cv2.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (cv2.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND cv2.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_card_id, SUM(reward_amount_krw) AS received_benefit_amount FROM user_benefit_usages WHERE usage_status = 'confirmed' AND usage_date >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01') AND usage_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY user_card_id ) benefit_usage ON benefit_usage.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots performance ON performance.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND performance.performance_month = #{yearMonth} WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY uc.display_order ASC, uc.user_card_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(outcome.missed_reward_value), 0) FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes outcome INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = outcome.user_card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE AND outcome.reward_unit = 'KRW' AND outcome.usage_date >= CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01') AND outcome.usage_date < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT ubu.usage_id AS benefit_history_id, approval.merchant_name, CASE bo.reward_type WHEN 'discount' THEN 'DISCOUNT' WHEN 'cashback' THEN 'CASHBACK' WHEN 'points' THEN 'POINT' END AS benefit_type, COALESCE(bo.offer_name, cb.title) AS benefit_title, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) AS card_name, approval.amount AS payment_amount, ubu.reward_amount_krw AS benefit_amount, COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) AS occurred_at FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN card_payment_approvals approval ON approval.approval_id = ubu.approval_id INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = ubu.user_card_id INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = c.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions cv2 WHERE cv2.card_id = cv.card_id AND (cv2.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (cv2.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND cv2.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) INNER JOIN benefit_offers bo ON bo.offer_id = ubu.offer_id INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.benefit_id = bo.benefit_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND bo.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) >= #{fromUtc} AND COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) < #{toUtc} ORDER BY COALESCE(ubu.approved_at, approval.approved_at) DESC, ubu.usage_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
